rationale: Marketing ops managers and Salesforce consultants are real buyers with budgets — Salesforce licence costs signal money is present — and the gap (no unified MI + Account Engagement dashboard without MC Next) is a genuine product limitation clients hit during paid implementations. However, building a reliable connector between Salesforce Marketing Intelligence, Account Engagement, and ad platforms requires Salesforce API expertise and ongoing maintenance as Salesforce changes its data model — this is meaningfully above 'Claude + simple page' territory. Signal is a single post with no validation. Total falls below the validate threshold.
solution_plan: Not recommended at this signal level. If validated: (1) the service is a lightweight reporting connector — pull Salesforce MI and Account Engagement data via API, merge with Google/Meta Ads data, produce a unified Google Looker Studio or Notion dashboard; (2) build as a Claude-orchestrated data pipeline + pre-built Looker Studio template + Stripe, but requires Salesforce API integration work (moderate complexity, not a one-week build); (3) sell to Salesforce implementation consultants via Salesforce partner communities and AppExchange listings — approvals required before outreach; (4) delivery is a configured dashboard + automated refresh, support handled by Claude FAQ. The main risk is Salesforce API complexity and client-specific data model variations requiring per-customer setup — validate with 3 consultants before building.
notes: Total 5.2 below min_total_to_validate (5.5). Also operational_autonomy (6) is borderline — per-customer dashboard configuration risks manual fulfillment. Monitor for stronger signal.
